description: This Java class defines a BiAnnualCompoundingPeriod for interest calculation in a savings domain, including methods for creating instances, calculating interest based on different methods, and handling end-of-day balances within a specified period.

classes.name: BiAnnualCompoundingPeriod
classes.description: Implements interest calculation logic for bi-annual compounding periods, managing end-of-day balances and computing interest based on different calculation types and periods.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a BiAnnualCompoundingPeriod instance with balances within a specified interval up to a certain date.

methods.name: calculateInterest
methods.description: Calculates interest based on the specified interest calculation type and compounding period type.

methods.name: calculateUsingAverageDailyBalanceMethod
methods.description: Calculates interest using the average daily balance method.

methods.name: calculateUsingDailyBalanceMethod
methods.description: Calculates interest using daily, monthly, quarterly, bi-annual, or annual methods based on end-of-day balances.

methods.name: endOfDayBalancesWithinPeriodInterval
methods.description: Filters and caps end-of-day balances within a given period interval up to a specified date.

methods.name: getPeriodInterval
methods.description: Returns the period interval for this compounding period.
